items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Nastase is one of the greatest tennis players I ever saw in my life. ... I'd like to know him.

ctx.x: McEnroe, he's a... And another guy that could do it, the only other guy I could put in that class -- Nastase.
Yeah, he's the one who started all that temper tantrum thing.
